title: Understanding SVD
text: The Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) of a matrix X is given by X $$=$$ $$ \cup {SigmaV}^T$$. Here, U and V are orthogonal matrices, and Σ is a diagonal matrix containing the singular values.

title: Principal Component Matrix
text: The principal component matrix P is obtained by multiplying the matrix U by the diagonal matrix Σ.

title: Expression for P
text: The expression for the principal component matrix P is P $$=$$ UΣ.

title: Calculate P
text: Using the expression for P, calculate the principal component matrix.
